Still disappointed it doesn’t work as expected—regret purchasing a year-long subscription.  UPDATE 03/2024: Offline mode is still not available! The app assumes constant internet access to stream HD content, which isn’t practical. Even with a strong signal (3 bars on Telstra), the app often fails to load.  Downloaded episodes are unusable without mobile service or when in flight mode, even with up to 3 bars of signal. This makes the app useless in places like the gym, where there’s no signal due to the building’s construction.  Please add an offline mode to make the app functional in these situations.
